title: Rogers-Ramanujan OQ-01-OQ-01: Finite Verification Through 8
description: Can the Rogers-Ramanujan identities be proved via q-series in Lean using PowerSeries from Mathlib?

problemStatement.formal: Verify, by native computation, the first and second Rogers-Ramanujan partition identities for n = 0 through n = 8.
problemStatement.plain: Records a finite computational verification slice for the Rogers-Ramanujan identities. The Lean file checks both Rogers-Ramanujan partition-count equalities through 8 while leaving the full q-series identity to the broader parent work.
whyMatters: Finite checks provide regression tests for the partition definitions used by the larger Rogers-Ramanujan project.
The two identity families exercise both gap and mod-5 partition encodings.
The metadata separates proved finite verification from the axiom-backed full q-series parent theorem.

proven: `rr1_n0` through `rr1_n8` verify the first Rogers-Ramanujan identity for n = 0..8.
`rr2_n0` through `rr2_n8` verify the second Rogers-Ramanujan identity for n = 0..8.
`rr_both_verified_through_8` packages the finite verification range for both identity families.
`PartitionTheoremOQ01OQ01.lean` is recorded with 0 axioms and 0 sorries.
open: The full infinite Rogers-Ramanujan q-series proof remains in the broader parent work and is not proved by this finite verification file.
Related parent partition files contain axioms or sorries outside this exact OQ-01-OQ-01 slice.
knownResults.goal: Expose the completed finite Rogers-Ramanujan verification results without overstating the full q-series theorem.
